**PTI Long March Day 7 Latest Update: Sohail Afridi Announces Swabi Interchange Plan as Federal Government Considers Major Steps in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa!**

The PTI Long March for Imran Khan’s release has reached Charsadda and is expected to move towards Mardan today, with Swabi Interchange emerging as the next major destination. KPK Chief Minister Sohail Afridi has announced a detailed schedule for PTI workers, parliamentarians, party office-bearers and supporters from across Pakistan to gather at Swabi Interchange on October 11, 13 and 14.

**Sohail Afridi’s Swabi Plan: What Happens Next?**

Sohail Afridi has directed PTI parliamentarians, organizational office-bearers and workers to begin reaching Swabi Interchange from across Pakistan. According to the announced schedule:

- **October 11:** PTI supporters from across Pakistan, including parliamentarians, party office-bearers and workers, have been asked to reach Swabi Interchange.
- **October 13:** Participants from Khyber Pakhtunkhwa’s Peshawar, Malakand and Kohat regions, including Karak, are scheduled to arrive at Swabi Interchange.
- **October 14:** Participants from the Hazara region, Bannu Division and Dera Ismail Khan Division are scheduled to join the gathering.
- **October 14 onward:** Sohail Afridi has announced that the next phase of the march will advance from Swabi Interchange, with further details of the route and strategy to be announced.

The announcement marks an important stage in the ongoing PTI Long March, which is being held to demand the release of former prime minister Imran Khan. The coming days will be crucial as the convoy moves through Charsadda and Mardan towards Swabi.

**Federal Government Considers Major Steps in KPK**

Meanwhile, the federal government is reportedly considering significant measures concerning Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, including the possibility of Governor’s Rule or emergency measures in 12 districts. These possibilities remain subject to official decisions and confirmation.

Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif has called a high-level meeting involving key stakeholders, with important decisions potentially on the agenda. The meeting comes amid the continuing PTI Long March and heightened political tensions between the federal government and the PTI-led KPK government.

snippet.description:
Muhtemel Aşk'ın 17. Bölümünde;

Kadir, Defne’nin Paris’e gitmesini engellemek için uçağa kadar peşinden 
giderken, ikilinin arasında patlayan kıskançlık krizi herkesi şaşırtacak bir 
noktaya ulaşır. Ancak onları bekleyen asıl sınav Güliz’in habersiz ziyareti olur. Güliz’in verdiği son karar, Kadir ve Defne’nin hayatını tamamen değiştirecektir. Kader’in Ali’ye gönderdiği gizemli doğum günü hediyesi ise yıllardır saklanan büyük bir sırrın kapısını aralar. Kadir ve Defne geçmişleriyle yüzleşirken, Tolga’nın hayatını altüst edecek gerçek de ortaya çıkmak üzeredir. Tam herkes yeni bir başlangıcın eşiğine gelmişken, Özlem ve Tolga’nın düğününde Ali’nin çözdüğü bir bulmaca dengeleri değiştirir. Nikah masasında herkesi darmadağın eden tek şey, herkesin içinde Ali’nin gerçeği söylemesidir.

snippet.title: Le ofrecieron 20 mil por traicionar a su hermano | Parte 2
snippet.description:
Tavo volvió al rancho con veinte mil y una propuesta: que Beto abriera el corral para llevarse cuatro novillos de Julián.

Pero cuando Julián vio a su hermano guardarse parte del dinero, explotó sin dejarlo explicar. Lo que parecía una traición tenía una cuenta pendiente detrás…

Una historia de hermanos, falsas amistades y dinero que pone a prueba la confianza. El humor está en cómo se hablan; el reclamo va en serio.

¿Tú habrías pensado lo mismo que Julián o habrías dejado hablar a Beto?

Parte 2: “No vendí las vacas, cabrón”.
